The controlling IP-09 design and assigned manifest require IP-08. I inspected the actual draft model, ellipsoid, cutoff algorithm, and full exact-risk theorem proof. Their conventions are real Hilbert coordinates, s_j>0 nonincreasing to zero, independent standard-normal noise with variance epsilon^2 s_j^-2, nondecreasing positive ellipsoid weights, and expected squared sequence loss. The scalar coordinate proof uses that model; the theorem and rate corollary use its exact-risk supplier. No supplier is absent; no acceptance is inferred.

The required page is published and its actual inventory was inspected: it includes two-point Le Cam, Assouad, Fano, product-KL additivity, and Gaussian KL suppliers. The assigned design requests a product-prior/hyperrectangle lower bound and warns that any reused testing/KL result needs a local inverse-experiment divergence calculation. The local proof constructs its own finite endpoint product prior and exact finite-coordinate likelihood ratio, so it uses no unverified inverse KL or imported Le Cam/Fano claim. The page requirement remains unchanged.

The actual draft Definition states Countable Choice and X_{nu,rho}(K)={|K|^nu w: ||w||<=rho}, with |K|^nu=(K^*K)^(nu/2) defined by compact spectral calculus. The local lemma proves both coefficient-set inclusions and uses no broader source-index regularity assumption.

The actual draft Statement and complete proof establish that every spectral source element lies in N(K)^perp under Countable Choice. The local ellipsoid identification uses this minimum-norm coefficient subspace and the same positive singular system.

The actual draft Definition fixes a complete right singular basis of N(K)^perp and an isometric bijection between its coefficient space and ell^2. The reverse inclusion constructs w from the weighted-square-summable coefficients through this exact map.

The actual draft Definition sets Theta_a(Q)={theta in ell^2: sum_j a_j^2 theta_j^2<=Q^2}, with positive nondecreasing weights and no assumption that a_j diverges. The source-ball lemma identifies Q=rho and a_j=s_j^-nu.

The actual draft Definition supplies positive-noise independent standard-normal coordinates on the product Borel sample space. The local scalar Statement spells out the one-coordinate density and squared-error decision problem used for the Bayes calculation.

The actual draft Definition states Z_j=theta_j+epsilon s_j^-1 xi_j, independent standard-normal xi_j, a real ell^2 parameter space, and the product Borel sample space. The theorem restricts to epsilon>0 and explicitly inherits the model's Countable Choice branch.

The actual draft Definition gives the nondecreasing positive weights and ellipsoid constraint sum_j a_j^2 theta_j^2<=Q^2, without requiring a_j->infinity. The box-budget argument preserves exactly that scope.
The actual draft Algorithm retains the first D sequence coordinates and sets all later coordinates to zero, including D=0. The minimax upper bound uses these admissible cutoff rules.

The actual draft theorem and complete proof give worst-case expected squared risk Q^2/a_(D+1)^2+epsilon^2 sum_(j<=D)s_j^-2 and the empty-sum convention at D=0. Its hypotheses match the local theorem; Countable Choice is inherited, while the finite product-prior argument uses no additional choice.

The local scalar lemma explicitly proves that the endpoint prior clipped to min(r,tau) has Bayes risk at least min(r^2,tau^2)/sqrt(2e). The product lower bound uses precisely that prior for each active coordinate.
The actual model fixes the positive singular-value sequence and the Gaussian noise variance epsilon^2 s_j^-2 used in each cutoff bias-variance balance.
The actual ellipsoid definition supplies Q and the positive nondecreasing weights a_j. The four cases impose the explicit polynomial or exponential axis asymptotics stated in the corollary.
The actual exact-risk theorem supplies the two terms being balanced: Q^2/a_(D+1)^2 and epsilon^2 sum_(j<=D)s_j^-2. The local proof bounds the minimization from both sides in all four regimes.
